Top Indian companies are listed in descending order of their market capitalization,{{cite web|title=Top Companies in India by Market Capitalization - BSE|url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/stocks/marketinfo/marketcap/bse/computers-software.html|publisher=moneycontrol.com|access-date=20 October 2015}} and other companies are listed alphabetically, grouped by the cities in which they are headquartered. Foreign companies that have a large presence in India are also included. There are IT companies of Indian origin headquartered in the US and other countries. Several foreign companies have more employees in India than in their parent countries.
